data.title: The AI data center boom is sparking fierce competition for skilled labor
data.description: The rapid expansion of AI data centers is transforming the construction industry by creating unprecedented demand for skilled workers, particularly electricians, The New York Times reports.  Large projects offer high wages, bonuses and significant overtime, drawing workers away from other construction projects and creating labor shortages in other sectors.
